name: Hitokata Yori
source:
Yori is a 3rd grader at Lilienne gakuen, an all-girls school. She is [url=/c24794]Hitokata Mai[/url]'s older sister and one of the candidates to be [url=/c24797]Kamishiro Yuu[/url]'s wife. Yori is the president of the school's executive department and everyone in the school admire her and call her "Onee-sama".

[Partially translated from the game's [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou4/index.html]official homepage[/url].]
